name: Citrus County, FL
findings: Citrus County has 394 nonprofit organizations. 156 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 121 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Citrus County has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Citrus County list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 73% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 88 organizations here; 35% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Citrus County list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 74% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 165 organizations here; 35% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 41 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 41 organizations here; 35% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?
